info.title: Khyari Spices E-commerce API
info.description:
RESTful API service for Khyari Spices e-commerce platform. This API provides endpoints for managing products, orders, customers, payments, and more.

**How to use Authorization:**
1. Use the `/api/v1/auth/login` endpoint to login and get a JWT token
2. Copy the `accessToken` value from the login response
3. Click the 'Authorize' button above and enter: `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE`
4. All subsequent API calls will include the JWT token automatically

**Example Authorization format:** `Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...`
